2014_spells.bigbys-hand.description: Create a Large hand of shimmering force.
2014_spells.bigbys-hand.effectSummary: Create a magical effect at a point you choose
2014_spells.bigbys-hand.fullDescription: Using 1 action, create a Large hand of shimmering force. Create a Large hand of shimmering force. The effect lasts for 1 minute; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
